name: Math and dates
summary: Exact arithmetic, percentages and date calculations, so the assistant does not guess.

tools.name: math.calc
tools.description: Evaluates an arithmetic expression exactly. Supports + - * / % ^ and parentheses, the constants pi and e, and sqrt, abs, round, floor, ceil, min, max, ln, log10, sin, cos, tan.

tools.name: math.percent
tools.description: Percentage maths: what percent of a number is, or a number increased or decreased by a percent.

op.description: of: percent of value; increase or decrease: value changed by percent

tools.name: date.diff
tools.description: Counts the days between two dates written YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: date.add
tools.description: Adds days (negative to subtract) to a date written YYYY-MM-DD and gives the new date and weekday.

tools.name: date.weekday
tools.description: Gives the day of the week for a date written YYYY-MM-DD.
